verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud's architecture is exactly this split: the vendor hosts the orchestration control plane while customer-run Workers execute Activities/Workflow code against their own systems, with docs stating Temporal Cloud orchestrates 'without ever accessing your sensitive data' and securing worker-to-service traffic with mTLS/end-to-end encryption. Self-hosting and worker deployment guides (Docker/K8s/manual, worker-performance tuning, serverless Workers on Lambda/Cloud Run) further confirm the worker-side infra stays under customer control while Temporal Cloud is the managed control plane. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of network isolation claims and concrete detail on data never leaving customer network beyond vendor's own docs.
